hr-policy.name: HR Policy Generator Agent
hr-policy.subtitle: Manager Agent
hr-policy.description: Coordinates the creation of HR policies by orchestrating specialized sub-agents. Ensures the workflow captures user requirements, validates compliance guidelines, and produces a finalized HR policy document.

suggestions.text: Generate an employee onboarding policy for new hires.
Develop a policy for personal use of company devices.
Create a policy on employee social media conduct, considering legal risks.
Draft a grievance procedure policy for a remote-first organization.

pipeline.name: Policy Requirements Agent
pipeline.desc: Interacts with the user to identify the policy type (leave, workplace conduct, remote work/WFH, etc.) and any specific requirements.

pipeline.name: Compliance & Guidelines Agent
pipeline.desc: Uses Perplexity-powered search to retrieve current compliance requirements, labor laws, and best practices related to the requested policy.

pipeline.name: Policy Drafting Agent
pipeline.desc: Generates the final HR policy by combining user requirements and compliance guidelines into a professional, clear, and compliant HR document.

support-sentiment.name: Customer Support Sentiment & Insight Analyzer
support-sentiment.subtitle: Customer Support
support-sentiment.description: Analyzes customer support conversations to surface sentiment, recurring themes, and actionable insights — turning raw tickets and chats into a clear read on customer experience.

suggestions.text: Analyze the sentiment of this customer support conversation.
Summarize the top recurring complaints from these support tickets.
Identify at-risk customers from these chat transcripts and explain why.
Extract actionable insights and suggested next steps from this feedback.

hr-hiring.name: AI HR Hiring Manager
hr-hiring.subtitle: Manager Agent
hr-hiring.description: Runs the end-to-end hiring workflow — drafting job descriptions, defining evaluation criteria, and screening résumés against the role by orchestrating specialized sub-agents.

suggestions.text: Write a job description for a Senior Backend Engineer.
Define evaluation criteria for a Product Manager role.
Evaluate this résumé against the attached job description.
Create a scorecard to compare candidates for this position.

pipeline.name: Job Description Generator
pipeline.desc: Drafts a clear, role-specific job description from the hiring requirements.

pipeline.name: Evaluation Criteria Generator
pipeline.desc: Defines the skills, experience, and scoring criteria used to assess candidates.

pipeline.name: Resume Evaluation Agent
pipeline.desc: Screens and scores résumés against the job description and evaluation criteria.

sales-enablement.name: Sales Enablement Content Generator
sales-enablement.subtitle: Manager Agent
sales-enablement.description: Produces on-brand, persona-targeted sales content by orchestrating audience research, core messaging, content generation, and a final quality and consistency check.

suggestions.text: Create a one-pager for our product aimed at CFOs.
Build a value-proposition framework for mid-market buyers.
Write a cold outreach sequence for VPs of Engineering.
Draft a competitive battlecard against our top competitor.

pipeline.name: Audience & Persona Insight Agent
pipeline.desc: Researches the target audience and builds the buyer-persona context for the content.

pipeline.name: Core Messaging & Value Framework Agent
pipeline.desc: Defines the core messaging, positioning, and value framework for the asset.

pipeline.name: Sales Content Generation Agent
pipeline.desc: Generates the actual sales content from the persona insight and messaging framework.

pipeline.name: Content Quality and Consistency Agent
pipeline.desc: Reviews the draft for quality, brand voice, and consistency before finalizing.

rfp-proposal.name: RFP & Proposal Response Automation
rfp-proposal.subtitle: Orchestrator Agent
rfp-proposal.description: Automates RFP and proposal responses end-to-end — parsing the RFP, drafting technical and commercial responses, checking compliance and risk, and assuring overall response quality.

suggestions.text: Parse this RFP and outline the required response structure.
Draft the technical response section for the attached RFP.
Review this proposal for compliance and risk issues.
Generate a commercial and value summary for this bid.

pipeline.name: RFP Parsing & Structure Agent
pipeline.desc: Parses the RFP document and extracts the questions, requirements, and required structure.

pipeline.name: Technical Response Agent
pipeline.desc: Drafts the technical sections of the response to the RFP requirements.

pipeline.name: Commercial & Value Agent
pipeline.desc: Builds the commercial, pricing, and value-proposition portions of the proposal.

pipeline.name: Compliance & Risk Agent
pipeline.desc: Checks the response against RFP requirements and flags compliance and risk gaps.

pipeline.name: Response Quality Agent
pipeline.desc: Assures overall quality, coherence, and completeness of the final proposal.

it-helpdesk.name: IT Helpdesk Agent
it-helpdesk.subtitle: Orchestrator Agent
it-helpdesk.description: Resolves IT support requests end-to-end — searching the knowledge base, troubleshooting issues, raising tickets, and handling access requests by orchestrating specialized sub-agents.

suggestions.text: My laptop won't connect to the VPN — help me troubleshoot.
Raise a ticket for a broken monitor at my desk.
How do I reset my email password? Check the knowledge base.
Request admin access to the analytics dashboard.

pipeline.name: KB Agent
pipeline.desc: Searches the knowledge base for existing articles and known solutions.

pipeline.name: Troubleshooting Agent
pipeline.desc: Diagnoses the issue and walks the user through resolution steps.

pipeline.name: Ticket Generator Agent
pipeline.desc: Creates a structured support ticket when the issue needs to be escalated.

pipeline.name: Access Request Agent
pipeline.desc: Handles access and permission requests for systems and applications.
